# Commands that delete plaintext must not follow a symlinked parent: with
# `sub -> trap`, removing sub/config would delete trap/config.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
mkdir sub
cp secret.txt sub/config
exec sesam add sub/config
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add secret'

rm sub
mkdir trap
cp secret.txt trap/config
symlink sub -> trap

! exec sesam clean --unsealed
stderr 'is a symlink'
exists trap/config

! exec sesam rm --force sub/config
stderr 'is a symlink'
exists trap/config
exec sesam ls
stdout 'sub/config'

-- secret.txt --
s3cr3t
